component.name: hapimatic-core
component.description: The Hapimatic open-source core: the single hapi executable built from the cli, server, web, and shared workspaces.

properties.name: hapimatic:scope
properties.value: runtime = production dependency closure of cli, server, web, shared (a superset of what is bundled); build = devDependency closure, not distributed

components.name: bun
components.description: The JavaScript runtime `bun build --compile` embeds in every hapi executable. Bun is MIT; it statically links JavaScriptCore/WebKit and tinycc (LGPL) and the permissively licensed native libraries listed below.

components.name: ripgrep
components.description: Prebuilt `rg` binary, one archive per platform under cli/tools/archives/, embedded in the executable and unpacked at first run (the `ripgrep` RPC).

components.name: difftastic
components.description: Prebuilt `difft` binary, one archive per platform under cli/tools/archives/, embedded in the executable and unpacked at first run (the `difftastic` RPC).

components.name: sherpa-onnx
components.description: Speech-recognition Node addon (with the onnxruntime shared libraries, MIT), downloaded from the npm registry and sha256-verified only when a user installs the optional voice-input extension. Never bundled into the binary.

components.bom-ref: hapimatic-manual:NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B (v2 and v3, int8)
components.name: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B (v2 and v3, int8)
components.description: Speech model downloaded from the sherpa-onnx releases, sha256-verified, only when a user installs the voice-input extension. The extension's UI shows the CC-BY-4.0 attribution (voice-input/artifacts.ts ENGINE_ATTRIBUTION).

components.name: Silero VAD
components.description: Voice-activity-detection model downloaded with the voice-input extension, sha256-verified.

dependsOn: hapimatic-manual:NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B (v2 and v3, int8)
